hexa_core.notes: First beta: dialogs, interaction points, instances, Discord and database logs, health check (hexa_check), security guard.

hexa_interact.notes: Full rewrite: cursor and wheel, menus and submenus, gamepad; replaces ox_target, qb-target, esx_context, esx_menu_default and esx_menu_list; vehicle, player, self, prop, carry, rob and furniture actions.

hexa_inventory.notes: Beta: ESX through the official ox_inventory path (no es_extended changes), hexa_check_inventory diagnostic, game-icons.net icons, unconditional search by default.

hexa_notify.notes: Rewrite: questions, dispatch, announcements, history; replaces esx_notify without modifying ESX.

hexa_progress.notes: Rewrite: bar, circle, 6 mini-games, server-side verification, ESX / QBCore / ox_lib redirects; replaces esx_progressbar.

hexa_progress_hacking.notes: Paid pack: code keypad, hacking, thermite, fingerprint, typing, padlock.
